chapter: On the road with Victor Spencer
title: Killing on the bandstand; the Washingtons and Nat Tolles's band
summary: They recap the death, and Lewis names Booker and Willie Washington and Nat Tolles's band.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: But anyway, how did this guy kill? He juged- Raised or something, knife or something like that.
Yeah. On the bandstand? Yeah, on the bandstand.
He just ran up there and killed him. You've heard about that, huh? Yeah, I heard he got killed, I didn't know. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, right over to Joyce Lewis.
I think his name was Gilbert.
He pushed Joyce Lewis in front of me. Should have pushed Father Al in front of me. You see the thing over there? You see, now a lot of stuff that you find out to do, you didn't know.

Yeah, that's right. Yeah. You see? Because I was in that section with those outfits. Did you play with them too? And they had Al, Booker's cousin Al, Al of Washington, Al, he died in Chicago, used to play tenor. Al was playing tenor with us out there.

Booker Washington used to play bass. He died. Oh yeah. Yeah, well that was his cousin. And they had another one, what they call, he's living back there kind of off now, Willie Washington, that's Booker's brother. He's back on Gileser Street out collecting insurance from him, you understand? Does he play music? Well he don't, having Joe Bentley and all that bunch used to play with Nat Tolles, you understand? Really? What they wanted to play with? They used to play out of Nat Tolles, Nat Tolles band, headquarters in the south was Monroe, but his headquarters was Nebraska Army Hall. And they had this little guy who used to play all that tenor. But him and Sam Dutry was a good friend. He's a radio technician now, what's his name? He played all that saxophone, big tone, big tone like Uskin Hawkeye, I can't think, there's so many of them guys, man. He lives here now? I don't know where he lives there. He could be, you know, he might be out there where Sam Dutry come, with his last wife Sam Dutry head out there.
